'''Niloc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] who attended the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Niloc was determined to pass the trials which [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Harkun]] instructed, but he disappeared during the trials and was likely [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />
